notes: AUTHORED VARIANT of carddemo-sort-creastmt (not CardDemo's deck): the same SORT and OUTREC, plus 329:22X, so each record is 350 bytes and matches the LRECL=350 of CardDemo's JCL SORTOUT DD and the 350-byte KSDS. IBM ends CardDemo's own 328-byte step with ICE043A (z/OS DFSORT Messages, Codes and Diagnosis Guide SC23-6879; register F4); padding the OUTREC to the LRECL is the manual's remedy. Used by carddemo-job-creastmt-padded to run STEP020 (IDCAMS) and STEP040 (CBSTM03A + CBSTM03B). Same 100 records (seed 8884), keys distinct.
